items.title: How many users a bug reaches at each canary percentage
items.description: This simplified model shows the blast radius of a bug at each canary percentage, assuming the bug affects every user routed to the new version. L3 uses hashing and gets approximate counts; this version uses a direct percentage so you can focus on the exposure idea. The rest of the rollout (total users minus the number shown) stays on the stable version, unaffected.
